pull_identity.title: AdaptiveNavigationBar: Painter images and native appearance styling on iOS
pull_identity.body:
Two additions to the iOS `UITabBar` behind `AdaptiveNavigationBar`:

- `UIKitImage.Painter` – draws any Compose `Painter` (e.g. `painterResource`) offscreen at screen density, so even-odd fills, strokes and bitmaps render correctly. Includes a `renderingMode` (template / original) for icons vs. photos. `UIKitImage.Bitmap` gains `scale` and `renderingMode`; `ImageBitmap → UIImage` now goes through PNG to keep alpha and channel order right.
- `UIKitTabBarConfiguration` – per-state icon/title colors, `titleFont` (`UIKitFont.System` / `UIKitFont.Named`) and `backgroundColor`, applied via `UITabBarAppearance`. Existing tint properties unchanged.

`TabBarManager` now updates items in place when only their content changes, so a late-loaded image no longer rebuilds the bar.

The navigation bar sample shows a `Painter` item next to the SF Symbol and `ImageVector` ones, plus a custom title font.

Verified on iOS 27 simulator. Note: Liquid Glass ignores unselected colors (tint and appearance alike).
